methodology.selection: Approximate entry-level unrestricted 1BR effective rent for one adult. Explicitly labeled open/urban 1BRs are accepted and noted. Prefer official property/operator availability and fee disclosures; use Zillow or Redfin as backup. Exclude income-restricted prices, per-bed shared-room rates, and explicitly unavailable/historical listings.
methodology.lease_term: Use the cheapest verified quoted option of at least 12 months when term-specific prices are exposed; otherwise assume 12 months and flag it. Longer quoted lease terms are amortized over their actual term. The Mercer only quotes a shorter lease: its annual approximation assumes the quoted monthly rent continues for 12 months, with renewal pricing unverified. Prices are snapshots, not guaranteed leasing quotes.
methodology.formula: ((monthly rent basis + mandatory monthly fees) * lease months + mandatory nonrefundable one-time fees - eligible concessions) / lease months
methodology.weeks_free: Free weeks converted to months as weeks * 12 / 52 and credited against base rent.
methodology.fees: Include disclosed mandatory recurring and nonrefundable one-time fees for one adult. Include published numerical utility estimates, labeled as estimates. Published total monthly prices already include mandatory fixed fees and are not charged twice. Exclude refundable deposits, holding payments credited to rent/move-in costs, optional parking/storage/pets, and unquantified charges. Zero recorded fees do not certify that no other fees apply.
methodology.concessions: Include ordinary free-rent and look-and-lease offers with documented eligibility or explicit assumptions. Exclude special employer/referral/credit-card qualifications. Select-unit and up-to offers without selected-unit support are generally not deducted; where applied, the assumption is recorded. Do not deduct offers twice from already net-effective advertised rents.
methodology.ratios: Median of within-building advertised 1BR/studio or 1BR/2BR rent ratios, using only Seattle-addressed buildings in the directory at pricing-research time with direct medium/high-confidence pricing and both rent types. No external market averages. Quotes may include mandatory fixed fees if inseparable from advertised rent; the paired advertised basis is retained. Already net-effective quotes and specifically flagged incompatible observations are excluded. Lowest available layouts, sizes and quoted terms can differ; the result is an approximate market relationship. The ratios remain a fixed snapshot of the pricing-research cohort before later amenity-based exclusions; filtering the active directory does not recalculate existing estimates. Pricing evidence for excluded cohort members is retained in generation-rules/research-audit.json under excluded.
methodology.extrapolation: When only studio or 2BR rent is usable, use studio first, otherwise 2BR. Multiply that rent basis by the matching median ratio; preserve disclosed fees as fixed dollar amounts and scale rent-proportional concessions. Extrapolated rents are hypothetical, not current 1BR availability.
methodology.rounding: Final apartments.json field is rounded to the nearest $10; this audit retains cents and source inputs.
methodology.missing: The ten buildings without a usable current unrestricted whole-apartment asking rent were removed from the active directory at the user's request on 2026-10-09. Their full records and no-pricing evidence are retained in generation-rules/research-audit.json under excluded. Missing pricing did not necessarily mean no vacancies existed.
methodology.amenity_exclusions: Eight buildings with exactly one normalized amenity other than Fitness center were removed from the active pricing records on 2026-10-09. Their unchanged pricing research is archived in generation-rules/research-audit.json under excluded.
